news.title: Rental Fighter Tickets! Test out additional characters during this campaign!
news.author: CAPCOM
news.body:
Curious about an additional character? Test them out using the special Rental Fighter feature! Claim a total of four Rental Fighter Tickets by logging into the game from Feb 10 to Feb 25.

➀ GMT: Feb 10, 08:00 AM - Feb 14, 07:59 AM ② GMT: Feb 14, 08:00 AM - Feb 17, 07:59 AM ③ GMT: Feb 17, 08:00 AM - Feb 21, 07:59 AM ④ GMT: Feb 21, 08:00 AM - Feb 25, 07:59 AM

Check out each character's introduction and gameplay trailer for more details on how to use them!

・Characters ・Character Guide

■What is a Rental Fighter?

This feature allows you to test additional characters you don't have for one hour in Fighting Grounds or Battle Hub. Claim a total of four Rental Fighter Tickets in the NEWS tab under "Try out the Rental Fighter Feature!" between Feb 10 and Feb 25! *Note: Rental Fighter characters cannot be used to join tournaments in the Battle Hub.

■How to Use Rental Fighter Tickets

Head to the Character Select screen from the Fighting Grounds or Battle Hub, pick a character you don't have, and then you're ready to go!

Selecting "Use Rental Fighter" allows you one hour of play with the selected character.
